task: gate 单模型训练方案与运行准备
scheduler_actual: LambdaLR(lambda epoch: 0.95 ** ((epoch - 1) / 10 + 1)); scheduler.step after each epoch
initialization: random initialization; isolated gate-off reference RNG alignment; no checkpoint warm-start
gate_formula: Fs=spectral state output; Fp=existing spatial state output; R=Fp-Fs; g=2*sigmoid(Conv2d(129,1,1)(concat(Fs,R,beta))); Fout=Fs+g*R

pca.transductive_limitation: All scene features participated in existing PCA. Test labels/metrics remain sealed.

dataloader.sample_order: existing row-major sample_index_map and split indices unchanged

validation.checkpoint_rule: maximum validation OA, >= selects later record

reference.source: accepted user-provided reference; full AutoDL train_config not read in this preparation

decision_rules.oa_less_or_equal: No OA benefit shown in this screening; stop. Report AA/Kappa without reframing the primary hypothesis.
decision_rules.oa_greater: Single-seed validation exploratory candidate only; report AA/Kappa, numerical health and limitations; no causal, cross-seed or formal performance claim.
decision_rules.no_automatic_followup: No seed/strength/structure sweep, test evaluation, extra training or general State Fusion
decision_rules.gate_weights_nonzero: Does not establish effective sample/location adaptation

gate_distribution_collection: Not proposed or enabled. Future analysis needs separate reviewed scope and forward budget.
